evidence.location: §4 phase table, LR3 row (LR3-C1); §6 risk table, row 'The labelled set carries text that cannot be redistributed'
evidence.observation: Plan LR3-C1 reads verbatim: 'the labelled set ships with a licence per source and a count of gold facts per fact type', and §6 ties it to redistribution safety with 'the licence of each source recorded in the set (LR3-C1)'. The delivered set carries one licence string for all twelve sources: src/gnd/examples/literature/reference_set.py:32-33 defines the single LICENCE constant and reference_set.py:105-109 writes it as the lone 'licence' key of labels.json; tests/test_lr3_reference_set.py:56 asserts only that labels['licence'] is truthy. close-results.md line 31 reports LR3-C1 'met' citing 'T1: licence note, counts 11/8/12 (A2)' — 'licence note', singular — without flagging the difference from the criterion's letter.

evidence.location: opening line and table rows X1–X11
evidence.observation: The delta opens 'Every departure from plan r4 as approved, with where it is recorded.' and closes 'No phase was dropped, and no criterion was relaxed.', yet none of its eleven rows records that the set ships one collective licence note instead of a licence per source.

concerns.recommendation: Add one close-delta row recording the departure — all twelve development documents are synthetic paraphrases under one licensing regime, so one note in labels.json covers them; alternatively extend labels.json with a per-source licence map and have T1 hold it. Recording it in the delta is sufficient; no observable behaviour needs to change.
concerns.title: LR3-C1's 'licence per source' ships as one collective licence note and the departure is missing from close-delta
